title: Ex-id Software devs reveal FPS Danger Pay 🔫
subject: dangerpay
description:
Would you back an FPS from ex-id developers? 👇

About 20 former id Software developers have formed Hidden Horses, an employee-owned independent studio, and announced Danger Pay, a single-player FPS set in a deadly game show run by an AI host, inspired by Smash TV and The Running Man.

Sources: Vertical Slice (Nov 11, 2026), Shacknews (Nov 11, 2026), 80.lv (Nov 12, 2026)

scenes.text: About 20 former id Software developers started a studio.
Hidden Horses is employee-owned. Every current member is a co-founder.
It follows 3,200 Xbox layoffs this summer, which 80.lv says cost id about half its staff.
Their first game, Danger Pay, is a single-player shooter set in a deadly game show hosted by a charming AI.
Influences include the arcade game Smash TV and the 1987 film The Running Man.
Engine programmer Dustin Land is a co-founder, and Kickstarter will cover part of the budget.
